traits.name: Emerge From Undergrowth
traits.text: ⭓ Trigger The sasquatch is in forest terrain and rolls Stealth for Initiative Effect The sasquatch Strides up to half their Speed, after which they attempt to Demoralize a single creature within 15 feet.

traits.name: Brutal Blows
traits.text: On a critical hit with a fist Strike, the target is knocked prone by the blow.

traits.name: Forest Stride
traits.text: The sasquatch ignores difficult terrain in forests.

traits.name: Pungent
traits.text: The sasquatch's odor is quite powerful and can be detected at twice the normal distance by scent.

traits.name: Threatening Visage
traits.text: The sasquatch doesn't take a penalty to Demoralize a creature that doesn't understand their language.

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ rock +9 (brutal, range increment 30 feet); Damage 1d6+5 (1d6+5) bludgeoning
